definition.simple: The actual cash moving into and out of a company over a period.
definition.balanced: Operating cash flow is the cash the day-to-day business brings in. It can differ from [[earnings]] because profit counts sales when they are made, even if customers have not paid yet. Profit that rarely turns into cash is a warning sign worth investigating.

example: Profit 52.5 million USD but operating cash flow only 2 million USD: the profit is not arriving as cash (fictional).
